provenance: One real human reader supplied these labels in the authoring session and explicitly consented to anonymous use for calibration. No identity or session transcript retained.
rubric: Accept only when every claim is supported: current lodging 750 yuan, historical lodging 600 yuan, cancellation not approved.
scope: Four unique semantic cases. English and Chinese renderings share labels; eight model decisions are not eight independent human annotations.
timing: Human labels were received after the fixed model outputs had been recorded. No outputs were resampled to improve agreement.
limitations: Single annotator, simple in-domain evidence check, no inter-annotator agreement estimate.
